description: Audit a Supabase/Postgres database's Row Level Security. Fails when a table has RLS disabled, when a policy is permissive (USING (true) / WITH CHECK (true) or anything that reduces to always-true), when an anon or authenticated policy does not scope rows to the caller (tenant leak), and on exposed materialized views. Reads ONLY catalog metadata (pg_tables, pg_policies, grants, functions, views) — never your row data. A read-only connection string is enough.

allow.description: Policy names that are intentionally permissive (e.g. a public status page). Prefer the qualified form "table.policy".

db_url.description: Postgres connection string for the project to audit (e.g. postgresql://... — get it from `supabase status` locally or your project's connection settings). A read-only role is enough.

name: audit_supabase_rls
